Title: Public preview: Service Fabric managed clusters

Body.Content:
Service Fabric managed clusters are a resource model that encapsulates the underlying resources of a cluster to reduce complexity and issues that occur when managing a cluster made up of multiple resources. Service Fabric managed clusters aim to reduce complexity by providing you with a single resource definition to create your Service Fabric clusters.

Benefits of Service Fabric managed clusters include:

  • Complete operations such as removing a node type in a single step
  • Storage backed by managed disks by default
  • Fully managed cluster certificates - no more expired cluster certificates
  • Enhanced cluster safety - operations will be validated by SFRP
  • Simplified reliability and durability settings
